mechanism: For Q6 selected down only, reuse each 160-byte D4 block's otherwise-unused raw-sum field for two exact int16 K16 quant sums. Compute them once in the producer and load them in the row64 integer-WMMA consumer instead of recomputing four dp4a sums in each of 48 output-column workgroups.
leaf_command: GPU_MAX_HW_QUEUES=1 HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 HIPENGINE_HIP_ARCH=gfx1151 HIPENGINE_COMPILER_VERSION_FILE=/tmp/laguna_hipcc_version.txt HIPENGINE_REQUIRE_CACHED_BUILD=1 PYTHONPATH=. .venv/bin/python3 -u scripts/laguna_q6_qmicro_leaf.py --samples 21 --warmups 3 --prefill-burst 7 --decode-burst 20 --compiler-version-file /tmp/laguna_hipcc_version.txt --require-cached-build --output /tmp/laguna-q6-precomputed-sums-inclusive-leaf.json

leaf.shape: layer 1, natural M512 routing, K1024, N3072, E256

full_model_command: GPU_MAX_HW_QUEUES=2 HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 HIPENGINE_HIP_ARCH=gfx1151 HIPENGINE_COMPILER_VERSION_FILE=/tmp/laguna_hipcc_version.txt HIPENGINE_REQUIRE_CACHED_BUILD=1 PYTHONPATH=. .venv/bin/python3 -u scripts/laguna_gate_doublebuf_ab.py --mode production=q6_wmma_prefetch_activation --mode candidate=q6_wmma_precomputed_sums --repetitions 11 --require-cached-build --output /tmp/laguna-q6-precomputed-sums-full-ab.json
decision: Retained and published on gfx1151 after clean selector-unset 512/1K/4K improved at every length and the traced pp512 Q6 window fell 0.905%. Keep the explicit rollback through the active 700 campaign, then collapse the layered Q6 selectors.
